cards.title: You earn your build now
cards.text: Runs start with no modules. Chests give them, level-ups level them, rarity caps how far.
cards.why: First time the game is a run rather than a test bench. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Version 0.4.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

The free build is still there: Pause → Practice build: On. That turns off chests and level-ups for that run.

parts.title: Chests
parts.text: Gold boxes in a quarter of dead ends and one in every hall, as you picked. Walk in to open: the game waits while you choose which cast gets the module, or scrap it for XP.

parts.title: Duplicates
parts.text: The same module in the same cast: a rarer one promotes yours (level kept, cap raised); same or lower gives +1 level. A full cast asks which module to replace.

parts.title: Level-ups
parts.text: 4 cards: +1 level to modules you have (below their cap), or you: health, speed, cooldowns, pickup range.

parts.title: Rarity
parts.text: Common 3, Uncommon 4 (green), Rare 5, Epic 7, Legendary 9: the level each can reach. Chests get rarer as the run goes on.

parts.title: Your build
parts.text: Pause → Build shows the run's modules and lets you move one to another cast; it keeps its level. Slots: Weapon 3, Spawn 2, Dash 2.

parts.title: More big rooms
parts.text: Your note: homing needs room. 9 halls now, up to 4×4 squares.

parts.title: Explode starts small
parts.text: Level 1 is a small, weak pop (1.7 cells, 8 damage); level 5 is 3.5 cells, 28.
